## **CASTING CALL FOR FEATURE FILM - CHEDDAR POP **

What started as a proof of concept short, has blown up to a full feature shoot!  “Cheddar Pop", is an independent, privately funded, feature that I wrote and will be producing from the ground up this year. It’s a comedy about a group of young movie theater workers who learn to rely on themselves and each other as they attempt to unionize their workplace.  We only succeed, together. 

Feature Film: “Cheddar Pop”

Location: Greater Aurora, CO. Area. Exact locations TBD

Shoot Dates: Now through December (**Extreme Schedule Flexibility a must since we will be filming in live business locations.)**

Project Type: Independent Feature Film (non-union, yes, we get the irony here)

Compensation: Unpaid, (for now) meals provided. Proportional cast profit splits when sold. 

Genre: Comedy

Logline: A group of theater employees find solidarity as they attempt to unionize their workplace and return to what made Cheddar’s Cinema a great place to work. Taking a stand at the concessions stand!

Roles available for any age or any level of experience. Character Descriptions and number of scenes here : [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1cAiAADfijNUpa9gNIxYqcP_g9JSIlx3KaBN0TLwOVCw/edit?usp=sharing) 

Email cheddarpopmovie@gmail.com for sides and Audition Notes. Submissions due by September 25, 2026. See less

CASTING CALL — POPO!
We’re looking for people interested in being part of a new comedy show/short film called “POPO,” a parody inspired by the style of COPS.

Location: Peninsula, Ohio

Filming begins TOMORROW and continues throughout this month

We’re currently looking for:

SUSPECTS — People willing to play ridiculous, funny, or suspicious characters.

WITNESSES — People who can give funny “interviews” and tell their side of the story.

DISPATCHERS — Potential voice-over roles for dispatch calls.

BYSTANDERS — People appearing naturally in the background or reacting to what’s happening.

COMEDIC CHARACTERS — Various funny and unusual characters throughout the show.

EXTRAS — Anyone who wants to be part of the scenes and help bring the world of POPO to life.

No professional acting experience is necessary. If you can improvise, have a sense of humor, or just want to try something different, we’d love to have you.

The idea is to make it feel like a serious police reality show while everything around the “officers” is completely ridiculous.

If you’re interested in participating, comment below or send me a message and let me know what type of role you’d be interested in.

POPO — Because somebody has to patrol Peninsula.

Message my account if interested.

**Szukasz nowych projektów albo dodatkowego zarobku? Właśnie otworzyliśmy pierwszą, przedstartową falę rejestracji na AlterCast!**

Jesteś aktorem, modelem, a może po prostu szukasz sposobu na pasywny dochód? U nas możesz zarabiać na własnym wizerunku. AlterCast to legalna platforma, która pozwala stworzyć Twojego cyfrowego "bliźniaka" do reklam.

Zapraszamy profesjonalistów, ale szukamy też osób o każdym typie urody (nie musisz mieć doświadczenia przed kamerą!).

**Zasady są proste i w 100% bezpieczne:**
**Pełna kontrola:** Sam decydujesz, w jakich branżach i projektach się pojawisz, a w jakich nie.
**Pieniądze za każde użycie:** Otrzymujesz od 1000 PLN za każdym razem, gdy marka wykupuje licencję na Twój wizerunek.
**Pełna legalność:** Umowa chroni Twój wizerunek, zero ukrytych haczyków.

**Dlaczego warto dołączyć już teraz? Mamy bonusy na start:** **Licencje od AlterCast:** W tym tygodniu nasza platforma sama będzie wykupywać licencje od pierwszych zarejestrowanych osób. **Płacimy za feedback:** Ponieważ to pierwsza fala, zależy nam na opinii. Załóż konto, przetestuj proces i napisz mi szczerze, czy wszystko było jasne – przewidzieliśmy za to dodatkowe wynagrodzenie dla 50 osób.

Rejestracja jest w pełni darmowa i do niczego nie zobowiązuje.

**Zostaw komentarz pod postem albo napisz do mnie od razu na priv!** Wyślę Ci link do założenia konta, opowiem o szczegółach i chętnie pomogę przejść przez cały proces rejestracji.

TV Production Partners: Cast, Crew & Investors

Are you a producer with a production studio looking for your next project? I am seeking experienced producers, investors, and industry professionals to help bring a finished TV show script to life.I have a finished TV show script. Now I need the team to make it happen.

I am looking for Producers and Production Studios who can invest in their own content. If you have a studio, a network of cast and crew, and PR connections in the entertainment industry, I want to talk to you.

What I Am Looking For:

Producers/Investors: Individuals or studios with the financial capability to invest in their own TV shows.

Production Studios: Access to your own facilities and resources to produce the project.

Network: Cast and crew who are ready to work on a new series.

PR: Professionals with connections in the entertainment industry to help with distribution and publicity.

If you have the infrastructure and the network to produce a TV series, I have the script. Let’s collaborate. Please answer the membership questions or DM me directly to discuss the project.

Models/Creator für Cinematic Shootings in Berlin gesucht 📸

Hey zusammen, ich bin Mustafa Kaan, Fotograf aus Berlin mit Schwerpunkt auf cinematic Urban Photography, Night, Portrait und Motion.
Für neue Projekte suche ich aktuell Models und Creator, die Lust auf atmosphärische, etwas außergewöhnlichere Shootings haben. Nacht, Stadtlichter, Neon, Bewegung und Storytelling statt klassischer Standard-Portraits.

Je nach Interesse fotografiere ich außerdem Boudoir, Sensual/Erotic Art und Creator Content. Für volljährige Models sind nach vorheriger Absprache auch Akt bis hin zu expliziterem Adult-Content (18+) möglich. Aufnahmebereiche und Grenzen werden immer vorher eindeutig abgesprochen, niemand muss etwas machen, womit er oder sie sich nicht wohlfühlt.
Für ausgewählte Ideen gerne TFP, außerdem bin ich auch für Pay-/Creator-Projekte offen.

Meine Arbeiten findet ihr hier:
https://mustafakaan.photo⁠

Instagram: @mustafakaan.photo

Wenn mein Stil zu euch passt, schreibt mir gerne eine PN und erzählt mir kurz, welche Richtung euch interessiert. 🙂

Moody. Night. Motion. Atmosphere.
